standard_description: IEC 62196-2 AC connector. Five-pin AC section of a CCS2 inlet.
notes: Description of the AC section is from source 19. A CCS2 inlet physically accepts a Type 2 AC plug.

standard_description: Combined Charging System Combo 2: Type 2 AC pins plus two DC contacts in one inlet. Benchmark DC standard on Indian public chargers.
Bharat EV Specification AC charging standard (low-power AC).
notes: Source 19 only confirms that Bharat specifications define AC and DC sub-categories. Plug/pin details NOT verified in this dataset.

standard_description: Bharat EV Specification DC charging standard; described as a modified GB/T connector with CAN communication, up to 200 V / 120 A (~15 kW).
notes: Source 17. Do not treat as interchangeable with GB/T DC or CCS2 without adapter documentation.
No Indian-market vehicle in this dataset is documented as using it.
Source 19 lists it for Tigor XPRES-T and e-Verito (conflicts with source 17).
